about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: 1st Call Local Plumbing & Heating Engineers has been serving Milton Keynes for 18 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown into a trusted team of Gas Safe registered engineers, but we've never lost our commitment to turning up fast and getting the job right first time. Every member of our team carries spare parts and tools so we can often fix your problem the same day you call.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on transparency: we quote upfront, charge fairly, and never upsell work you don't need. Thousands of Milton Keynes households and businesses return to us year after year because they know we'll answer the phone, arrive promptly, and solve the problem without drama. We're local, we're experienced, and we genuinely care about looking after your home.
reviews_heading: What Milton Keynes Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator just before Christmas. Called 1st Call and Jamie came out the same evening. He had it sorted in 45 minutes, price was fair, and he even helped move some furniture back. Brilliant. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a freezing Friday night. Thought we'd be without heat all weekend. Called at 8pm and they were here by 9. Fixed a faulty valve, tested the whole system, and explained everything as they went. Top-notch service. Already recommended them to three friends.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. The team were tidy, professional, and actually explained the warranty and controls properly. Not like the last plumber we had. Heating bills down already and we sleep better knowing it's all new and safe. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Helen P.
